scope: One reduced SD15 square case; same managed graph, original and copied native packages on one Linux CPU host

independentSecondAudit.qualification: none; single reduced case package contrast

qualificationLimits: The core libraries and OpenMP package change together; no individual binary, compiler flag or primitive implementation is isolated
Source nativeLibraries fields inventory wheel files; they are not actual loaded-module maps
Product maps attest the relevant images observed after calculation, not every possible later library load
Borrowed input alignment differs between source and product and between native packages; intermediate inputs at the first divergence agree
Large native payload and hardlink facts are producer-attested; those files are not uploaded or independently rehashed after download
Artifact archive digests are GitHub-reported, not locally rehashed ZIP digests
First-difference order in this audit follows source captures, correcting only the interpretation of producer product/product ordering
No native runtime adoption, model compatibility, stock-width, GPU or cross-platform qualification follows
